title: project
$comment: ONE canonical record per project (kills F1: acme was 59 fragments -> here it is 1). Carries the transversal triad: context+flow (load-once, stable) · status (operational, current) · to-do/backlog (operational). Tasks live as referenced child records; the graph lives in edges. Capability is referenced from the umbrella, never copied here.

context.$comment: Triad: what it is + the end-to-end flow. The one place narrative is legitimate (load-once, stable).

tasks.$comment: Child task records by id (one record per task; not inlined narrative).

umbrella.$comment: Parent umbrella id (umbrella-of-one for personal projects).
